label: concept visualisation, not survey-verified, not construction-ready, not certified CAD
scope_note: Brochure interiors p15/p16, material board p17 and spec text p24 are PROJECT-level. None is verified as a 4B room; applying them to 4B rooms is an inference.
design_intent: Warm-minimal 'quiet luxury': pale beige stone-look floors, white/greige textured walls, mid-to-dark walnut-tone veneer joinery, Calacatta-style marble/porcelain and travertine features, bronze metal trim, black linear ceiling lights, cream/taupe upholstery with muted sage and navy accents. Exterior tie-in: beige stone and bronze/timber slats from the 4B exterior concept set.

rules: No people, no watermarks, no brochure logo/branding
Windows/doors only where V4 plan shows openings
Service rooms (pantry, laundry, K.store, maid room/bath, lift, MEP, RF pantry/powder) restrained: white paint, light porcelain, plain light veneer or white units, stainless fittings
Wet areas follow p24: terrazzo-look or concrete-look porcelain; Calacatta only as one feature panel
